result = build_feature_matrix(dummy_df, formula_col='formula_pretty')
print('Result shape:', result.shape)
print('Columns count:', len(result.columns))
# Check some feature names exist (element fractions)
cols = list(result.columns)
feature_cols = [c for c in cols if c not in ['formula_pretty', 'material_id']]
print('Feature columns count:', len(feature_cols))
print('Sample feature names:', feature_cols[:5])
